gui.guhs.vadskracht.telt_deels: Counts for %s%%: after %s %s a guh gets a bit lazy, nyeg
gui.guhs.vadskracht.afnemend: %s Guh Wheels in this setup: together still %s%% as chonky. Better build a second setup!
block.guhs.guh_wheel.lore.afname: The first 4 Guh Wheels in a setup count in full. Every wheel after that gives 75% of the one before: guhs don't like running in a traffic jam.
block.guhs.knabbelketel.lore: A boiler with a guh face that burns cheese nibbles. Right-click with nibbles or a block of cheese nibbles (that burns nine times as long), or let a Nibble Pipe fill it. Smells of melted cheese.
block.guhs.knabbelketel.lore.kracht: Gives %s chonk power and eats %s cheese nibbles an hour
block.guhs.knabbelketel.koud: The boiler is cold: throw in some cheese nibbles!
block.guhs.knabbelketel.brandt: It burns: %s nibbles left in the tray, this nibble %s more seconds
block.guhs.knabbelketel.gevoerd: Nom! %s nibbles in the tray now
block.guhs.knuffelsteen_generator.lore: Cheese sauce and water meet and out rolls cuddlestone, on 4 chonk power: 60 a minute. Put it next to a water source and only cheese sauce has to go in. The stones go into a chest, the bank or a pipe next to it by themselves.
block.guhs.knuffelsteen_generator.water_: Water from the source next to it: free, nyeg!
block.guhs.saustank.lore: A Sauce Vat with steel hoops for 64 buckets of one sauce. A meter sits on its belly. Pick it up and the sauce comes along. Almost a swimming pool of cheese sauce.
block.guhs.sausbuis.lore: A thick pipe for sauce over long distances. Joins pumps, vats, tanks, hoses and sauce machines by itself, and counts as only a sixteenth of a hose: up to 4096 pipes in one line.
block.guhs.weer_vadser.lore.straal: Radius %s blocks. With a Cloud Antenna on top or next to it that grows up to %s: right-click the Weather Vadser with the antenna
block.guhs.wolkenantenne.lore: Weather Vadser radius %s blocks, costs %s chonk power
block.guhs.wolkenantenne.lore.hoe: Put it on top of or next to the Weather Vadser, or right-click the Weather Vadser with it. First I, then II, then III.
gui.guhs.weer.antenne.al: This Weather Vadser already has Cloud Antenna %s or better
gui.guhs.weer.antenne.eerst: First Cloud Antenna %s, nyeg: one cloud at a time
gui.guhs.weer.antenne.erin: Cloud Antenna %s on! Radius now %s blocks, costs %s chonk power
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.vb_knabbelketel.desc: The &6Nibble Boiler&r burns cheese nibbles for &d80 chonk power&r. A block of cheese nibbles burns nine times as long. Hungry, though: hundreds of nibbles an hour. Time for a nibble farm!
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.vb_generator.title: Soft stone
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.vb_generator.desc: Cheese sauce + water = &dcuddlestone&r. Put the &6Cuddlestone Generator&r next to a water source, give it cheese sauce through a hose and chonk power, and put a chest next to it.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.vb_saustank.title: A pool of sauce
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.vb_saustank.desc: The &6Big Sauce Tank&r holds 64 buckets. The meter on its belly shows how full it is.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.vb_sausbuis.title: Pipes all the way
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.vb_sausbuis.desc: A &6Sauce Pipe&r carries sauce far: it only counts as a sixteenth of a hose.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.vb_antenne.title: Weather all around
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.vb_antenne.desc: A Weather Vadser only reaches 10 blocks. Put a &bCloud Antenna&r on it: I, II and III make the radius 20, 35 and 60. Every step costs more chonk power.
